dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Moderate falcation characterized by a concave spline fitting the trailing edge from the apex to the posterior base insertion.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphology with a broad pixel radius at the fin's highest vertical point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 45-50 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal ridge, exhibiting a convex anterior contour.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.3:1 ratio of longitudinal base width to maximum vertical pixel height.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple linear white rake marks or superficial scars on the lateral flank; a distinct small notch is visible on the lower third of the dorsal fin's trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive high-intensity specular highlights (glittering) distributed across the mid-lateral wet integument.
